<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
from_numpy(array: np.ndarray) -> Tensor
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Wrap a numpy array as a `Tensor` without copying.

The tensor shares memory with `array` (no implicit copy); the device is
the default CPU device. This is the dtype-preserving, zero-copy wrap
path — unlike `tensor`, the array's dtype is kept exactly as-is
(no float64 → float32 default-dtype coercion).

## Parameters

- `array` · `np.ndarray` — The numpy array to wrap.

## Returns

- `Tensor` — The new `Tensor`.
